codeReview.summary: The ViewportPass implementation is well-designed and thoroughly tested. The code follows existing Katla conventions, integrates cleanly with the frame graph architecture, and provides a solid foundation for multi-viewport rendering. All requirements from the feature description are met: viewport passes render to transient textures, multiple viewports can coexist in the same frame graph, and each viewport has independent configuration (extent, format, clear color, camera uniforms). The implementation includes comprehensive unit tests (12 tests) and integration tests (8 tests) covering all major scenarios including split-screen, grid layouts, different formats, and independent camera configurations.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed the frame graph pass template pattern from AGENTS.md/library/architecture.md. The ViewportPass implementation matches the existing pattern used by GeometryPass, UIPass, and FullscreenPass: struct with builder methods, PassBuilder trait implementation, explicit resource dependency declaration, and proper error handling. The code demonstrates good understanding of transient texture usage and render graph synchronization.

summary: ViewportPass integration is complete and meets all requirements. The implementation provides a clean API for creating viewport passes that render to transient textures, supports multiple concurrent viewports with independent configurations, and integrates properly with the frame graph's resource management and dependency tracking. Code quality is high with comprehensive test coverage (20 tests total), proper error handling, and good documentation. No blocking issues found.
